key: OPAL SHUTTER UNLOCKED
en: OPAL SHUTTER UNLOCKED
ja: オパールシャッター解除

key: SANDY: You made it!
en: SANDY: You made it!
ja: サンディ: 来られたんだ!

key: Okay, there shouldn't be any issue here!
en: Okay, there shouldn't be any issue here!
ja: よし、ここは特に問題ないはず!

key: I brought some tools, so let me just quickly open this up, change out the filter, and we'll be on our way!
en: I brought some tools, so let me just quickly open this up, change out the filter, and we'll be on our way!
ja: 道具は持ってきたから、これをサクッと開けてフィルターを交換したら、すぐ移動するよ!

key: Just make sure no one is coming, okay?
en: Just make sure no one is coming, okay?
ja: 誰も来てないか、見張っててくれる?

key: SANDY: I'll just move this, unscrew this...
en: SANDY: I'll just move this, unscrew this...
ja: サンディ: これをこう動かして、ここのネジを外して……

key: Yep, yep, okay--
en: Yep, yep, okay--
ja: うんうん、よし――

key: Um...
en: Um...
ja: コールマン: あの……

key: \PN?!
en: \PN?!
ja: \PN?!

key: Something's coming out!
en: Something's coming out!
ja: 何か出てくる!

key: SANDY: I'm still holding this filter together; can you--
en: SANDY: I'm still holding this filter together; can you--
ja: サンディ: まだフィルターを押さえてるから、悪いけど――

key: ...GULP.
en: ...GULP.
ja: ストップレッツ: ……ゴクリ。

key: SANDY: Got it!
en: SANDY: Got it!
ja: サンディ: よし、捕まえた!

key: Phew!
en: Phew!
ja: ふう!

key: Those little guys suddenly appearing really surprised me!
en: Those little guys suddenly appearing really surprised me!
ja: あの子たち、急に出てきてびっくりしたよ!

key: I wonder where they all came from?
en: I wonder where they all came from?
ja: 一体どこから来たんだろう?

key: ADRIENN: So the "disturbance" that was reported to me...
en: ADRIENN: So the "disturbance" that was reported to me...
ja: アドリエンヌ: つまり、私に報告された「異変」というのは……

key: ...Was just you again.
en: ...Was just you again.
ja: ……また君だったというわけか。

key: SANDY: Oh, ahaha~ Where did you come from?
en: SANDY: Oh, ahaha~ Where did you come from?
ja: サンディ: あ、あはは~ どこから来たの?

key: We were just doing a regular inspection of the center to make sure everything was in proper working order!
en: We were just doing a regular inspection of the center to make sure everything was in proper working order!
ja: ちゃんと動いてるか、センターの通常点検をしてただけだよ!

key: No problems here, yup!
en: No problems here, yup!
ja: ここは何にも問題なし、うん!

key: Well, we'll be moving right along!
en: Well, we'll be moving right along!
ja: それじゃ、あたしたちはこれで失礼するね!

key: ADRIENN: Then what's that you're holding?
en: ADRIENN: Then what's that you're holding?
ja: アドリエンヌ: では、君が手に持っているそれは何だ?

key: SANDY: W-what, this old thing?
en: SANDY: W-what, this old thing?
ja: サンディ: な、何、この古いやつ?

key: It's just a...
en: It's just a...
ja: これはただの……

key: ...Piece of junk, yup!
en: ...Piece of junk, yup!
ja: ……ガラクタだよ、うん!

key: I found it laying around so I was gonna go throw it away!
en: I found it laying around so I was gonna go throw it away!
ja: そこら辺に落ちてたから、捨てに行こうと思ってただけ!

key: ADRIENN: I don't suppose that "junk" would happen to be a filter for that machine.
en: ADRIENN: I don't suppose that "junk" would happen to be a filter for that machine.
ja: アドリエンヌ: まさか、その「ガラクタ」があの機械のフィルターだったりはしないだろうね。

key: SANDY: Whaaaaat?
en: SANDY: Whaaaaat?
ja: サンディ: なぁにぃ?

key: Pshaw, you're crazy!
en: Pshaw, you're crazy!
ja: やだ、頭おかしいんじゃない!

key: \PN, isn't xe crazy?
en: \PN, isn't xe crazy?
ja: \PN、この人ちょっとおかしいと思わない?

key: There's no way I'd just happen to have taken this filter out of that machine or something!
en: There's no way I'd just happen to have taken this filter out of that machine or something!
ja: あたしがたまたまあの機械からこのフィルターを抜き取ってた、なんてことあるわけないでしょ!

key: ADRIENN: ...Uh huh.
en: ADRIENN: ...Uh huh.
ja: アドリエンヌ: ……ふうん。

key: All right, so supposing, just hypothetically, right?
en: All right, so supposing, just hypothetically, right?
ja: よし、では仮に、あくまで仮定の話としてだが。

key: Supposing you did take that filter from that machine...
en: Supposing you did take that filter from that machine...
ja: 君があの機械からそのフィルターを抜き取ったと仮定して……

key: Why would you have done that?
en: Why would you have done that?
ja: なぜそんなことをするのだろうか?

key: SANDY: Just hypothetically, right!
en: SANDY: Just hypothetically, right!
ja: サンディ: あくまで仮定だよね!

key: Umm, well, I suppose if that were something I would have done...
en: Umm, well, I suppose if that were something I would have done...
ja: ええと、そうだね、もしあたしがそんなことをしたとしたら……

key: It must have been because this filter was passing cleaning chemicals that would be unhealthy for the Pokémon in Azurine Lake...
en: It must have been because this filter was passing cleaning chemicals that would be unhealthy for the Pokémon in Azurine Lake...
ja: このフィルター、アズリン湖のポケモンに悪い浄化薬品を通しちゃってたはずだから……

key: ...And so I would have replaced it with one that would make the water even purer!
en: ...And so I would have replaced it with one that would make the water even purer!
ja: ……水がもっときれいになる新しいのに交換したんだと思う!

key: ADRIENN: And, in this hypothetical scenario...
en: ADRIENN: And, in this hypothetical scenario...
ja: アドリエンヌ: それで、その仮定の話の中で……

key: Just where would you have gotten a filter like that?
en: Just where would you have gotten a filter like that?
ja: そのようなフィルターを、一体どこから手に入れたのだろうか?

key: SANDY: Um... That's--
en: SANDY: Um... That's--
ja: サンディ: えっと……それは――

key: ADRIENN: And would it have been an illegal acquisition?
en: ADRIENN: And would it have been an illegal acquisition?
ja: アドリエンヌ: それは、不正な入手方法だったりするのかな?

key: SANDY: Ahaha, it's just hypothetical, so who really knows!
en: SANDY: Ahaha, it's just hypothetical, so who really knows!
ja: サンディ: あはは、あくまで仮定だから、誰にも分かんないよ!

key: ADRIENN: ...
en: ADRIENN: ...
ja: アドリエンヌ: ……

key: SANDY: B-besides! There were a bunch of Gulpin crammed into the machine anyway!
en: SANDY: B-besides! There were a bunch of Gulpin crammed into the machine anyway!
ja: サンディ: そ、それに! どのみち、あの機械にはベトベターがぎゅうぎゅうに詰まってたんだから!

key: So, it was a good thing!
en: So, it was a good thing!
ja: だから、良いことをしたんだよ!

key: ADRIENN: And just how would you know that if you hadn't actually opened it?
en: ADRIENN: And just how would you know that if you hadn't actually opened it?
ja: アドリエンヌ: 実際に開けてもいないのに、それをどうして知っているのだろうか?

key: SANDY: U-um...
en: SANDY: U-um...
ja: サンディ: え、えっと……

key: ADRIENN: For your own sake, I hope you never have to testify in a court of law.
en: ADRIENN: For your own sake, I hope you never have to testify in a court of law.
ja: アドリエンヌ: 君のためを思って言うが、法廷で証言する羽目にだけはならないことを願うよ。

key: All right, listen.
en: All right, listen.
ja: さて、聞いてくれ。

key: The truth is, I've known that some of the chemicals permitted by the existing filter would probably still be harmful.
en: The truth is, I've known that some of the chemicals permitted by the existing filter would probably still be harmful.
ja: 実のところ、今のフィルターで許可されている薬品の一部は、やはり有害だろうと私も分かっていた。

key: Unfortunately, a certain corporation has had their hands in the restoration financially and their ambassador has been trying to pull us around for it.
en: Unfortunately, a certain corporation has had their hands in the restoration financially and their ambassador has been trying to pull us around for it.
ja: あいにく、ある企業が復興事業に資金面で関わっていて、その代表者にあれこれ振り回されているのでね。

key: That person has significantly different values from many of us, and is only concerned about what can save them money.
en: That person has significantly different values from many of us, and is only concerned about what can save them money.
ja: その人物は、私たちの多くとはまるで価値観が違っていて、金の節約になることしか気にしていない。

key: And regrettably, that same company is the one we would have needed to finance this filter.
en: And regrettably, that same company is the one we would have needed to finance this filter.
ja: それに残念ながら、このフィルターの資金を出してもらう必要があるのも、同じその企業なのだ。

key: So here's what I'm going to do.
en: So here's what I'm going to do.
ja: だから、私はこうしようと思う。

key: I'm going to report that the disturbance down here was just a gaggle of Gulpin, and nothing more.
en: I'm going to report that the disturbance down here was just a gaggle of Gulpin, and nothing more.
ja: ここでの異変は、ただのベトベターの群れだったと報告することにする。それ以上でも以下でもない。

key: And I'm going to forget I ever saw you here.
en: And I'm going to forget I ever saw you here.
ja: そして、ここで君を見たことは忘れることにする。

key: Please dispose of that filter somewhere no one will find it.
en: Please dispose of that filter somewhere no one will find it.
ja: そのフィルターは、誰にも見つからない場所に処分してくれ。

key: But let us please not cross paths like this again.
en: But let us please not cross paths like this again.
ja: だが、二度とこんな形で顔を合わせることのないようにしてほしい。

key: SANDY: Well, that could have gone worse!
en: SANDY: Well, that could have gone worse!
ja: サンディ: まあ、もっと悪い結果もあり得たよね!

key: But what xe said about that corporate ambassador really concerns me...
en: But what xe said about that corporate ambassador really concerns me...
ja: でも、あの人の企業の代表者についての話、すごく気になるな……

key: I won't let Reborn rot again!
en: I won't let Reborn rot again!
ja: リボーンをまた腐らせたりしないんだから!

key: Hmm... I know!
en: Hmm... I know!
ja: うーん……そうだ!

key: Let's sneak into the Grand Hall and find that corporate office!
en: Let's sneak into the Grand Hall and find that corporate office!
ja: 大ホールに忍び込んで、あの企業のオフィスを見つけよう!

key: Then we can put an end to their dark grasp on the city once and for all!
en: Then we can put an end to their dark grasp on the city once and for all!
ja: そうすれば、この街に対する連中の暗い支配に、ついに終止符を打てるはず!

key: Skip cleaning the water on this file?
en: Skip cleaning the water on this file?
ja: このファイルで水の浄化をスキップする?

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ
